about: The game's art slots: everything the 3D view draws, by name. Read by ArtKit (client3d/art_kit.gd), the terrain pass and the art tools; the fields and conventions are in docs/art_style.md. A slot's own art goes in art/kit/<category>/<slot>/: <slot>.glb (variants <slot>.2.glb ...) with its <slot>.blend beside it, or <slot>.png for a texture slot. Until then it is drawn from its fill (a third-party piece, from 'sources') or as a grey box.

wall.castle.profile.uses: the castle set: outdoor fortifications. A wall set's runs (decision 287); its variation is what terrain's sweep varies per run, tuned here without code: sway (a fraction of the height), broken (a share of the cap broken), gap (a share of breaches), lean (degrees per run at most), jitter (metres), sag (metres, post to post). the cross-section terrain sweeps along each wall run (terrain part 4); the body below cap_y may be raised, lowered, notched or broken per segment, the band above it is kept whole
